scope: Outcome-independent descriptive verification and publication-report contract for the development-only sensor-aware ordinal folds-3/4 experiment. This contract cannot select, tune, blend, recalibrate, promote, or authorize protected evidence.
execution_preconditions: The native continuation process has exited with code zero.
The compact result, candidate predictions, endpoint states, both held-part access receipts, and both held-part completion receipts exist and are immutable.
The compact result access ledger records held folds exactly [3,4], comparator semantic decode true, folds 0/1/2 false, and external/official evidence false.
Every frozen path and available SHA-256 value matches before a scientific value is decoded.

scene: absolute candidate and comparator average precision pooled
absolute candidate and comparator average precision by outer fold
absolute candidate and comparator average precision by sensor
candidate-minus-comparator average-precision deltas matching the frozen compact result
candidate and comparator recall at each FPR in [0.005,0.01,0.02,0.05,0.10]
per-FPR and mean matched-FPR recall deltas
dense: aggregate observable-pixel TP, FP, and FN for candidate and comparator
absolute aggregate IoU for candidate and comparator
candidate-minus-comparator aggregate IoU matching the frozen compact result
uncertainty: the frozen 10000-replicate paired 25 km group AP-delta lower bound
the frozen 10000-replicate paired 25 km group dense-IoU-delta lower bound
all seven preregistered promotion checks without reinterpretation

requirements: Recompute pooled, fold, and sensor AP deltas from immutable aligned arrays.
Recompute the five-point matched-FPR recall curve and its mean delta.
Recompute aggregate dense IoU from integer TP/FP/FN counts.
Require every recomputed delta to match the compact result within tolerance.
Do not search thresholds, weights, checkpoints, seeds, subgroups, or report variants.

paper_context.interpretation: The paper numbers are historical official-benchmark context only. Development folds 3/4 are a different cohort and cannot establish paper-test superiority.

required_sections: exact paper-v3 comparator and stronger reconstructed archive
data boundary and one-shot access chronology
absolute development metrics and all seven gates
publication_report.claim_language_if_development_passes: The sensor-aware ordinal candidate passed its preregistered folds-3/4 development gate against the frozen Gaussian+DOFA development champion; official MARS-S2L superiority remains unevaluated.
publication_report.claim_language_if_development_fails: The sensor-aware ordinal candidate failed at least one preregistered folds-3/4 development gate and was rejected without protected or official evaluation.
publication_report.forbidden_claim_until_exact_official_gat: ERSRR outperforms MARS-S2L on the authors' official benchmark.

commit: code, configuration, tests, hashes, and paper-facing prose
ignore: credentials, signed URLs, and authenticated cookies
